_doc: How building work goes day by day (systems/construction.js), for everything raised as a project: the player's roads, bridges and other infrastructure (data/infrastructure.json buildTime, in work-days on open level ground), properties and tech buildings (data/playerEconomy.json, data/technology.json constructionDays), temples and shrines (data/religion.json), cultural buildings of the player and the AI crowns (data/culture.json), and holding projects (data/holdings.json days). A build needs its work-days done; each day adds `pace` of them: season[the season] x weather[today's weather on the hex] x (1 + crews.speedPerCrew x hired crews), never below minPace. So a 10-day road laid in winter snow takes far longer, and two extra crews take a third off it. Work goes on whether or not the builder is there to watch. Roads, irrigation and dams are slower across hard ground: terrain[the hex's terrain] x their buildTime (river: x more for a road over a river hex). crews: a crew is `hands` labourers hired in the nearest town at its land wage x wageMult a day, paid from the builder's purse into the town's (real coin, both ways); at most `max` crews; a crew unpaid for a day walks off.
